description: This file contains unit tests for the absl::time::civil_time module, testing construction, formatting, parsing, arithmetic, comparison, and edge cases of civil time classes like CivilSecond, CivilMinute, etc.

classes.name: absl::CivilSecond
classes.description: Represents a civil second with year, month, day, hour, minute, second components.

classes.name: absl::CivilMinute
classes.description: Represents a civil minute with year, month, day, hour, minute components.

classes.name: absl::CivilHour
classes.description: Represents a civil hour with year, month, day, hour components.

classes.name: absl::CivilDay
classes.description: Represents a civil day with year, month, day components.

classes.name: absl::CivilMonth
classes.description: Represents a civil month with year and month components.

classes.name: absl::CivilYear
classes.description: Represents a civil year with a year component.

classes.name: absl::Weekday
classes.description: Enumeration of weekdays used in civil time calculations.

methods.name: absl::FormatCivilTime
methods.description: Formats civil time objects into ISO-like string representations.

methods.name: absl::ParseCivilTime
methods.description: Parses strings into civil time objects, strict format.

methods.name: absl::ParseLenientCivilTime
methods.description: Parses strings into civil time objects, lenient format.

methods.name: absl::GetWeekday
methods.description: Returns the weekday for a given civil date.

methods.name: absl::NextWeekday
methods.description: Returns the next civil date matching a specified weekday.

methods.name: absl::PrevWeekday
methods.description: Returns the previous civil date matching a specified weekday.
